prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universally “best” interior painter for St. Louis — the right company depends on your needs (home size, whole-house vs. a few rooms, budget, timeline, whether you need repairs or specialty finishes). I can help you find the best fit. A couple options for how to proceed:

1) If you want me to recommend specific companies I can research current top-rated options for your exact area — tell me your ZIP code (or neighborhood), scope (number of rooms / square footage), and timeline.
2) Or I can give you a shortlist of how to evaluate painters and what to ask so you can pick one confidently.

Quick guidance while you decide:

How to pick the best interior painter
- Look at recent local reviews (Google, Yelp, Angi) and photos of completed jobs.
- Verify insurance and business license (ask for proof).
- Get at least 3 written estimates with a clear scope (prep work, number of coats, paint brand, trim/ceiling included).
- Ask for references from recent similar projects and contact them.
- Confirm warranty/repair policy and cleanup expectations.
- Check whether they provide color consultation and sample/patch testing.

Questions to ask every painter
- Are you insured and licensed in St. Louis County / City? Can you provide proof?
- Do you include surface prep, caulking, sanding, and minor drywall repair in the price?
- Which paint brands and sheen do you use? Is premium paint included?
- How many coats are included and how long will the job take?
- Do you move/cover furniture, and how do you protect floors?

Typical cost ballpark (St. Louis area, estimates)
- Per interior room: ~$300–$800 (small to medium rooms)
- Per square foot: ~$1.50–$3.50
- Whole-house (2,000 sq ft): ~$3,000–$7,000
(Actual price depends on prep, ceilings, trim, repair work, and paint quality.)

If you want, give me your ZIP code and a brief project description and I’ll pull together a short list of top-rated interior painters in your area and suggested questions to ask each.
